theme_and_context.vibe: Cinematic, Agentic OS, Architecturally precise, High-Contrast Swiss Brutalism

typography.alignment: Optical alignment, primarily left-aligned text to anchor the strict grid, intentional asymmetric off-center large headings.

colors.rules: PURE MONOCHROME. Strictly black and white. Use inverted sections (white on black) to create emphasis without color.

visual_enhancers.borders: Line-based structure. Heavy horizontal rules (border-t-4, border-b-4) to separate major sections. 1px borders for grid items.
visual_enhancers.textures: Layered subtle textures like monochromatic noise/grain overlays using CSS mix-blend-mode or pseudo-elements to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid colors only. NO gradients. NO glassmorphism. Flat solid backgrounds to maintain brutalist clarity.
visual_enhancers.decorations: ASCII art motifs in backgrounds or loaders to reinforce the 'Agentic OS' narrative.

grids_and_layouts.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-0 (using border-collapse strategies)
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 to provide breathing room inside sharp containers. All bordered containers MUST have internal padding.
sections_list: 2. Cinematic Hero & Brand Story: Massive serif typography, noise texture, and motion-intensity toggle.
3. Agentic OS Problem/Solution: Split screen, inverted colors (black bg, white text).
4. How it Works: 4-step linear grid (Intent, AST compilation, Orchestration, Trust) with heavy borders.
5. Product Capabilities (Bento Grid): Visual builder, Hybrid RAG, CRDT, Sandboxing, MCP, Multimodal, Autoscaling.
7. Watch Demo: Interactive iframe embed wrapped in a strict structural box.
8. Industry/ICP Stories: Minimalist cinematic portraits with large quote typography.
10. Resources/SEO Field notes: Ticker/Marquee or dense list layout.
12. Footer with CTAs: 'Watch Demo', 'Book a Call', 'Join Waitlist'.

motion.philosophy: Cinematic and Intentional, but highly accessible.
motion.types: Sharp reveals, simple opacity fades, discrete line-drawing animations.
motion.motion_intensity_control: MANDATORY (P2 item). A visible toggle in the header/nav to switch between 'Cinematic (High Motion)' and 'Reduced Motion'.
motion.accessibility: Must heavily utilize `prefers-reduced-motion` media queries and the custom motion-intensity state. When reduced, replace parallax and heavy transitions with instantaneous or simple opacity changes.

accessibility.contrast: Exceeds APCA and WCAG AAA (pure black and white).
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast 2px solid outlines (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-black dark:ring-white).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via CSS and JS.

media.handling: Images should be strictly monochromatic (grayscale) or heavily desaturated to fit the pure black/white theme. Max overlay opacity: bg-black/50.

3d_libraries.usage: Use raw Canvas/WebGL for a subtle ascii or noise generation. Avoid heavy 3D models to keep the strict minimalist 2D typography vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Monochrome Minimalist design: ONLY use black (#000) and white (#FFF).
Replace generic fonts. Use Cormorant Garamond (or similar display serif) for headings, JetBrains Mono (or similar mono) for body and labels.
Implement sharp corners (`rounded-none`) everywhere. Do not use border radius.
Structure the layout using heavy lines (`border-t-2`, `border-b-4`, `border-black/white`).
Create a 'Motion Intensity' toggle (Low/High) in the SiteChrome header to satisfy the P2 requirement, and tie it into Framer Motion/CSS classes.
Embed the existing exported HTML demo (from `frontend/demo`) securely into an iframe inside the 'Watch Demo' section.
Ensure 'Book a Call', 'Join Waitlist', and 'Watch Demo' are distinctly separated CTA sections.
Build the 'Newsletter Capture' component inside the footer or a dedicated section using sharp, brutalist form inputs.
Tell the 'Agentic OS' story using alternating inverted sections (black bg with white text vs white bg with black text).
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'SaaS' aesthetics. Avoid rounded corners, soft drop shadows, and gradients.
Create depth through strict typography sizing and extreme contrast.
Implement the 'Tetris' grid strictly using CSS grid with pure HTML/Tailwind.
Do not center-align everything. Use optical alignment, often left-aligning large blocks for readability and architectural rigidity.
Use generous padding (2x-3x normal) inside bordered containers to avoid cramped text.
Do not use AI assistant emojis 🤖🧠. Use sharp, technical SVG icons (Lucide/Phosphor) if required.
All interactive elements MUST have hover states (e.g. inverted colors on hover) and focus rings.
